data.text: You hear raucous cackling and spot the crackle of a burning fire. Carefully approaching, you spot a circle of luggage gremlins, two lounging inside idling cars, gathered around a bonfire pouring out thick black smoke. Dozens of canisters of train fuel lie scattered carelessly nearby, presumably to be used as fuel for the fire. You could secure a large cache of fuel here, if you can manage it.

text: You carefully sneak away, not wanting to deal with this quite yet.
With your understanding of the airport's security system, you're able to quietly call in backup from the main terminal.
Within minutes, two burly security guards approach with an eyebot hovering between them. Gremlins screech and scatter, preparing for battle. You'd better help out.
You emerge from hiding and show the assembled gremlins your button.
There's some cheering, some laughing, and a lot of varyingly painful pats on the back.
You explain your situation as best you can with the language barrier and are eventually rewarded with most of the assembled cache, though they retain a little to keep the fire burning a while longer.
You lug the fuel away, waving farewell to the gremlin circle.
Well, better get on with it. You prepare for battle.
